items.raw_excerpt: A small church in Uppsala hides the grave of a renowned 18th-century astronomer.
items.summary_en: In Uppsala, Sweden, a small church holds the grave of Anders Celsius. He was an 18th-century astronomer known for the Celsius temperature scale. The grave is easy to miss and quiet to visit.
items.summary_ko: 스웨덴 우프살라의 작은 교구에 18세기 천문학자 안데르스 셀시우스의 무덤이 있다. 그는 섭씨 온도 척도를 만든 사람이다. 이 무덤은 눈에 잘 띄지 않아 조용히 둘러볼 수 있다.
items.title_en: A Quiet Church Grave in Uppsala Holds a Famous Astronomer

items.raw_excerpt: Lonely Planet adds Spanish city of León to 2027 global must-visit list, website selling Spain-England football tickets hacked, Spanish PM slams housing crisis 'tragedy' after pensioner evicted and more news on Thursday September 24th.
items.summary_en: The travel guide Lonely Planet put the Spanish city of León on its list of places to visit in 2027. A website that sells Spain and England football tickets was also hacked. The prime minister called the housing situation a tragedy after an old man was kicked out of his home.

items.raw_excerpt: Austria agrees a much bigger fuel-price brake and parliament approves the new Aktivpension, plus more stories from Austria on Thursday.
items.summary_en: The Austrian parliament has approved a new pension plan called Aktivpension. The government also agreed on a bigger fuel price brake. It is meant to help people with high fuel bills.

items.raw_excerpt: The Hindu, in association with Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL), hosted The Hindu Sustainability Summit 2026 on Wednesday (September 23, 2026).
items.summary_en: The Hindu held a sustainability summit in Chennai on September 23, 2026. Local oil company CPCL joined as a partner. The event brought people together to talk about green growth and clean energy.

items.raw_excerpt: Nominations for the 2026 International Emmy Awards were announced on Thursday (Sep 24) morning, Singapore time.
items.summary_en: Two CNA documentaries are on the 2026 International Emmy Awards nominee list. The full list was announced on Thursday morning, Singapore time. These awards are a global television prize given to nonfiction and fiction shows each year.

items.raw_excerpt: Health New Zealand has put a temporary halt on Dannevirke Community Hospital taking new patients while it finds more clinical staff, following a number of resignations.
items.summary_en: Health New Zealand has paused new patient admissions at Dannevirke Community Hospital. The hospital needs more clinical staff after several staff members resigned. It is still caring for patients who are already there.

items.raw_excerpt: As the weather turns crisp and leaves scatter the streets, you might find yourself dreaming about spending a day in a cozy little village. Ontario has no shortage of quaint small towns, but this charm...
items.summary_en: A small village in Ontario has stone shops and cozy cafes that feel like the Cotswolds in England. The writer invites readers to spend a quiet day walking its streets on a crisp autumn day. It is an easy day trip for anyone who lives nearby.
